questions.question: Change 4 m, 1 m 35 cm and 1 m 5 cm into centimetres, and explain the last one.
questions.expected_answer: 4 m is 400 cm. 1 m 35 cm is 100 plus 35, which is 135 cm. 1 m 5 cm is 100 plus 5, which is 105 cm; the 5 cm goes in the units place, so it is not 150 cm.

questions.question: Find a quarter of a metre and three quarters of a kilometre.
questions.expected_answer: A quarter of a metre is 100 cm divided by 4, which is 25 cm. A quarter of a kilometre is 1 000 m divided by 4, which is 250 m, so three quarters is 3 times 250, which is 750 m.

questions.question: 3 m of ribbon is cut into 4 equal pieces. How long is each piece?
questions.expected_answer: 3 m is 300 cm. 300 divided by 4 is 75, so each piece is 75 cm long.
